field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Only the three mandated GGUF model ids may enter the corpus.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Known row, receipt, license, checker, and partition attacks fail closed.
field_principles.authentic_family_count: Readiness requires all three authenticated model families.
field_principles.autotokenizer_usage_count: Bare zero proves no AutoTokenizer path ran.
field_principles.cached_sota_pair_receipts: Helper-call receipts prevent manual model substitution.
field_principles.corpus_disjointness_receipts: Fresh row hashes are compared against V550 and V551 fixture hashes.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time is measured without padding.
field_principles.embedded_gguf_tokenizer_receipts: Tokenizers come from GGUF metadata, not AutoTokenizer.
field_principles.exact_label:clean: The checker labels a clean row when the typed effect matches the target.
field_principles.exact_label:contradicted: The checker labels contradicted rows when the proposed effect opposes the target.
field_principles.exact_label:duplicate: The checker labels duplicate rows without treating raw bytes as duplicate.
field_principles.exact_label:implicit: The checker labels implicit rows after deriving the target from source fields.
field_principles.exact_label:stale: The checker labels stale rows when an old revision makes the effect wrong.
field_principles.exact_label:superseded: The checker labels superseded rows when a later source cancels the effect.
field_principles.exp6413_gate: The gate proves execution only, not semantic correctness.
field_principles.exp6413_gate_receipt: The Exp6413 gate proves the three GGUF families ran authentically.
field_principles.field_principles: Every required field states its guard.
field_principles.field_provenance: Every required field maps to specs, inputs, receipts, tests, or exact checks.
field_principles.fresh_factor_event_corpus_ready_score: The score is one only when every narrow corpus gate passes.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict starts with an allowed terminal prefix and states the narrow claim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate declares Exp6413 authenticated GGUF receipts plus fresh exact corpus rows.
field_principles.license_and_frozen_harness_bindings: Cell-local licenses and frozen harness hashes prevent inheritance.
field_principles.manifest_path_hash_counts_balance_classe: The fresh 72-row manifest is sealed before parsing.
field_principles.model_file_and_tokenizer_hashes: Model bytes and embedded tokenizer hashes bind every row.
field_principles.model_output_substitution_count: Bare zero proves raw hashes were not swapped after generation.
field_principles.models_used: Only families accepted by Exp6413 count as used.
field_principles.partition:acquisition: Acquisition rows exercise first-seen evidence without future labels.
field_principles.partition:future: Future rows exercise duplicate and superseded evidence after row freeze.
field_principles.partition:retention: Retention rows exercise stale and implicit evidence without cross-row writes.
field_principles.per_cell_transport_evaluability_correctn: Every model-family cell reports independent transport, exact, abstention, and cost counts.
field_principles.per_row_authenticated_process_and_raw_ou: Each raw row binds to a process receipt and stored bytes.
field_principles.per_row_source_effect_license_and_exact_: Each row binds source spans, typed effect, license state, and exact label.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions bind date, upstream gates, models, tokenizers, manifests, hashes, and labels.
field_principles.prompt_config_event_order_and_checker_fr: Prompts, config, order, and checker hashes freeze before raw parsing.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Conductor, ops, traceability, and upstream evidence remain byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_leakage_count: Bare zero proves labels stayed hidden before row freeze.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed pins event order and raw row construction.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A normalized checksum detects artifact drift.
field_principles.silent_fallback_count: Bare zero proves no cell inherited another family.
field_principles.status: Terminal status separates ready, blocked, and null corpus evidence.
field_principles.tests_run: Verification command exit codes gate readiness.
field_principles.universal_support_claimed: Bare false prevents a universal support claim.
field_principles.unlicensed_cell_abstention_records: Unlicensed or unsupported cells abstain without fallback.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Bare true applies only to deterministic factor-event checkers.
